items.title_zh: 鳄鱼盟友哎呀！费城球迷因情绪支持鳄鱼而被拒绝入场
items.title_en: Alligator ally oops! Phillies fan denied entry with emotional support gator
items.summary_zh: 社交媒体上的帖子描绘了周三，沃利加托（WallyGator）戴着一条刻有他名字的安全带，被拴在体育场外。 WallyGator 是一只为宾夕法尼亚州琼斯敦的 Joie Henney 服务的治疗性鳄鱼，它在各种社交媒体平台上拥有大量追随者，人们经常看到它在社交媒体平台上进行深情互动，例如拥抱和亲吻。这位爬行动物明星在 Instagram 和 TikTok 上占有重要地位。
items.summary_en: Posts on social media depicted WallyGator, donning a harness adorned with his name, tethered outside the stadium on a Wednesday. WallyGator, a therapeutic alligator in service to Joie Henney of Jonestown, Pennsylvania, enjoys a vast following on various social media platforms, where he is frequently observed engaging in affectionate interactions, such as hugging and kissing. This reptilian star boasts a significant presence on Instagram and TikTok.
